en.text: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

zhSimplified.text: 约雅敬年间，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上到 犹大；约雅敬服事他三年，然后背叛他。

zhTraditional.text: 約雅敬年間，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒上到 猶大；約雅敬服事他三年，然後背叛他。

en.text: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使迦勒底军、亚兰军、摩押军，和亚扪人的军来攻击约雅敬，毁灭犹大，正如耶和华借他仆人众先知所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使迦勒底軍、亞蘭軍、摩押軍，和亞捫人的軍來攻擊約雅敬，毀滅猶大，正如耶和華藉他僕人眾先知所說的。

en.text: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

zhSimplified.text: 这祸临到犹大人，诚然是耶和华所命的，要将他们从自己面前赶出，是因玛拿西所犯的一切罪；

zhTraditional.text: 這禍臨到猶大人，誠然是耶和華所命的，要將他們從自己面前趕出，是因瑪拿西所犯的一切罪；

en.text: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.

zhSimplified.text: 又因他流无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷；耶和华决不肯赦免。

zhTraditional.text: 又因他流無辜人的血，充滿了耶路撒冷；耶和華決不肯赦免。

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

zhSimplified.text: 约雅敬其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

zhTraditional.text: 約雅敬其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。

en.text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 约雅敬与他列祖同睡。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 約雅敬與他列祖同睡。他兒子約雅斤接續他作王。

en.text: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及王不再从他国中出来；因为巴比伦王将埃及王所管之地，从埃及小河直到幼发拉底河都夺去了。 （代下36·9—10）

zhTraditional.text: 埃及王不再從他國中出來；因為巴比倫王將埃及王所管之地，從埃及小河直到幼發拉底河都奪去了。 （代下36‧9－10）

en.text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 约雅斤登基的时候年十八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫尼护施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。

zhTraditional.text: 約雅斤登基的時候年十八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫尼護施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿單的女兒。

en.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

zhSimplified.text: 约雅斤行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父亲一切所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 約雅斤行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他父親一切所行的。

en.text: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的军兵上到耶路撒冷，围困城。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的軍兵上到耶路撒冷，圍困城。

en.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

zhSimplified.text: 当他军兵围困城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒就亲自来了。

zhTraditional.text: 當他軍兵圍困城的時候，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒就親自來了。

en.text: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大王约雅斤和他母亲、臣仆、首领、太监一同出城，投降巴比伦王；巴比伦王便拿住他。那时是巴比伦王第八年。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大王約雅斤和他母親、臣僕、首領、太監一同出城，投降巴比倫王；巴比倫王便拿住他。那時是巴比倫王第八年。

en.text: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.

zhSimplified.text: 巴比伦王将耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物都拿去了，将以色列王所罗门所造耶和华殿里的金器都毁坏了，正如耶和华所说的；

zhTraditional.text: 巴比倫王將耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物都拿去了，將以色列王所羅門所造耶和華殿裏的金器都毀壞了，正如耶和華所說的；

en.text: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

zhSimplified.text: 又将耶路撒冷的众民和众首领，并所有大能的勇士，共一万人，连一切木匠、铁匠都掳了去；除了国中极贫穷的人以外，没有剩下的；

zhTraditional.text: 又將耶路撒冷的眾民和眾首領，並所有大能的勇士，共一萬人，連一切木匠、鐵匠都擄了去；除了國中極貧窮的人以外，沒有剩下的；

en.text: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 并将约雅斤和王母、后妃、太监，与国中的大官，都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去了；

zhTraditional.text: 並將約雅斤和王母、后妃、太監，與國中的大官，都從耶路撒冷擄到巴比倫去了；

en.text: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 又将一切勇士七千人和木匠、铁匠一千人，都是能上阵的勇士，全掳到巴比伦去了。

zhTraditional.text: 又將一切勇士七千人和木匠、鐵匠一千人，都是能上陣的勇士，全擄到巴比倫去了。

en.text: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

zhSimplified.text: 巴比伦王立约雅斤的叔叔玛探雅代替他作王，给玛探雅改名叫西底家。 （代下36·11—12；耶52·1—3）

zhTraditional.text: 巴比倫王立約雅斤的叔叔瑪探雅代替他作王，給瑪探雅改名叫西底家。 （代下36‧11－12；耶52‧1－3）

en.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

zhSimplified.text: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

zhTraditional.text: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。

en.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

zhSimplified.text: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。

en.text: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己面前赶出。

zhTraditional.text: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己面前趕出。
